to be a retail-dealer, drive a petty trade, , , , , (Delos, iii B. C.), (iv A. D.); δι' ἀψύχου βορᾶς σίτοις καπήλευ' drive a trade, chaffer with your vegetable food, .

(Cogn. with Lat. capio, haben, Heft.)
